ModMetaData.name: Pick Up and Haul - Reworked
ModMetaData.author: Zzyxzz
ModMetaData.description:
Colonists pick up several things into their inventory and haul them to a stockpile in one trip.
A reworked version of Pick Up And Haul by Mehni for RimWorld 1.6 and 1.7. It fixes many bugs of the original, works with Combat Extended again and searches faster in big colonies. Colonists keep their own supplies apart from what they haul.
Use it instead of the original, not together with it. Existing saves keep working when you swap.
Original mod by Mehni, with code from AlexTD, Angelin01, Bradson, simplyWiri, erdelf, Zorba, Why_is_that, Dingo, CodeOptimist, Hanabishi, Madara Uchiha, Ragnar-F and bananasss00. Kept running by Mlie. Released under the MIT licence.
Source code: https://github.com/Zzyxz/RimWorld-PickUpAndHaulReworked
